mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates through accommodative monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate financing costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 5.0% signal labor market weakness and economic deceleration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue growth faces headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate declines and CPIAUCSL increases indicate stagflationary pressures where monetary policy fails to control inflation, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise with SPX 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate increases exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signal active monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher discount rates suppress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1000 thousand units indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as housing activity supports broader economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 103.0 index points signals strong manufacturing output and economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits benefit from higher goods demand.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 103.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent labor market strength (PAYEMS > 140,000 thousand persons) and consumer spending strength (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars) indicate a robust economic cycle, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS > 140,000 and RSAFS > 450,000 fails to predict positive SPX 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1000 thousand units signal declining consumer confidence and economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as housing sector weakness drags down overall economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST falls below 1000.0.
